meta.homeTitle: Bénin AgroMarket — Market prices, finally legible
meta.homeDescription: 2019–2026 price history, seasonal patterns, and 3-month ahead forecasts with uncertainty intervals for white maize, tomato, and white yam (kokoro) across Benin's markets.
meta.explorerDescription: Explore historical price trajectories, monthly seasonal profiles, and spatial price spreads across Benin's well-tracked staple markets.
meta.forecastDescription: 1-, 2-, and 3-month ahead retail price forecasts with 80% and 90% uncertainty intervals and test reliability diagnostics.
meta.methodDescription: Leakage-free evaluation protocol, simple method comparisons, NASA POWER weather analysis, and operational model limits.

reliability.no_better_than_simple: No better than the simple method in testing

units.nominalRetailNotice: Nominal retail prices in XOF/kg (West African CFA franc).
units.marketsDefinitionNote: Well-tracked markets: markets with at least 80 months of price records out of 93 between January 2019 and September 2026.
units.testErrorTooltip: Average gap between forecasts and actual observed prices across the 12 test months (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026).
units.seasonalIndexTooltip: 100 = yearly average level over the 2019–2026 period.

hero.title: Market prices, finally legible.
hero.subtitle: Maize, tomato, yam: price history, seasonal cycles and 3-month forecasts across Benin's markets, with their honest limits.
hero.productSelectorLabel: Commodity displayed in chart and map:

stories.title: Three staples, three price dynamics
stories.subtitle: Every figure below is computed directly from the well-tracked market series (at least 80 months of price records out of 93 between 2019 and 2026).
stories.computedProseTemplate: Across the {count} well-tracked markets (2019–2026), prices are on average lowest in {troughMonth} and highest in {peakMonth} — a {ratio}× ratio between the seasonal peak and low.
stories.sparklineCaption: Monthly median across tracked markets over 36 months (XOF/kg)
stories.sparklineScaleNote: Each chart uses its own vertical scale (36-month min–max)

mapSection.title: One kilogram, different market realities
mapSection.subtitle: Geographic position of well-tracked markets for the selected staple (latitude / longitude). Dot shade shows how each market's latest observed price (September 2026) compares to the median of tracked markets.
mapSection.rampExplanation: Dimmer = cheaper · Brighter = more expensive (5 steps relative to median)
mapSection.latestMonthOnlyNote: Figures computed for the latest observed month only (September 2026).
mapSection.selectedMarketHint: Hover, tap, or keyboard-focus any market dot on the map to inspect its coordinates, price, and forecast.
mapSection.tableAlternativeToggle: Show accessible data table of all well-tracked markets

forecastTeaser.title: What the 3-month forecasts say
